knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Crazing and soft spots are signs of failure. The sheet is treated as fragile until controls have been set up.
A physical edge control comes first. A sign or a ladder warning is not an edge control.
Materials near an edge can fall on people below, and they can also trip or block a worker.

practicalCriteria: Identifies the fragile or brittle areas in a supplied roof photograph or description, and marks them
Specifies the edge control and the access method for a supplied roof
States the stop-work condition for a roof with a planted sign of failure
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Roof condition note for a supplied scenario
Assessor observation of the stop decision
stopWorkCriteria: Any roof treated as safe without a check is stopped
Work near an unprotected edge without an edge control stops at once
